name: translation-toolkit
description: Agent-facing contract for the translation toolkit. Human docs live in docs/; this file is the machine-readable index.

status.purpose: One-call project status: units, terms, TODOs, check and global results, blocking items.

check.purpose: Project-level QA: terminology, punctuation, footnote/figure counts, untranslated runs.

global_check.purpose: Whole-book structural comparison between source/*.md and chapters/*.tex.

style.purpose: 思维阁: list, inspect or apply a translator style profile.

build.purpose: Generate, compile with XeLaTeX, copy PDF, run check; stdout is one JSON line.

exit_codes.1: blocking issue, invalid arguments, or unreadable project

conventions.json_mode: With --json, stdout contains only one JSON document; logs go to stderr or are suppressed.
conventions.project_root: A directory containing project.json and main.tex.
conventions.units: One chapter file in chapters/ plus its source/<stem>.md counterpart.
conventions.terms_authority: glossary/terms.csv is the only authority for terminology.

guardrails: Never commit copyrighted source text, translations or ebook files.
New terms must be added to glossary/terms.csv before use.
Preserve all source footnotes; use \zhu{} for translator notes.
Mark uncertainty with \todo{reason}; clear before final check.
